a: position: sticky toggles between relative and fixed based on scroll within a container.
z-index stacks positioned elements; stacking contexts can limit its effect.
Specificity ranks selectors: inline > id > class/attr/pseudo > element.
@layer controls cascade priority groups for large stylesheets.
clamp(min, preferred, max) creates responsive values without many breakpoints.
Container queries style based on parent size, not only the viewport.
grid-template-areas names regions for readable page layouts.
aspect-ratio maintains width/height proportion for media boxes.
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) adapts to system dark mode.
will-change hints browsers about upcoming animations; use sparingly.
